result.description:
What You’ll Do 
 
This role is a full-time, permanent position based in Wollongong, NSW (postcode 2500), working within Sicona’s Pilot Plant facility. This role offers an annual salary package from $76,515 - $85,000 plus superannuation commensurate to the candidates experience and level of qualifications. As an entry level position, the candidate will be appropriately trained and supervised to operate within the Plant. You’ll contribute to Sicona’s long-term objective to deliver high performance battery materials at mass market scale, without costing the earth. 
- Support day-to-day operations and maintenance schedules as part of the engineering operations team.    
- Monitoring, adjusting and operating assets at operational sites to meet KPIs.   
- Support the design, procurement, installation, testing and commissioning of current and / or new facilities, as well as turnaround and inspection activities (T&I).   
- Identification of faults through the use of fault-finding techniques followed by troubleshooting and rectification of problems.   
- Contributing to and enhancing continuous improvement initiatives for safety systems.    
- Working in a professional, timely and safe manner following all Sicona and NSW - WHS standards and procedures.    
- Identification, classification, handling and disposal of chemical waste/chemicals according to Sicona’s safety protocols throughout the production process.    
- Reporting incidents, hazards and near misses according to procedures, including conducting investigations as directed by the line manager.   
- Writing of in-depth reports & analysis of operational output reports, providing recommendations & actions and ensuring approved recommendations and actions are implemented or managed.    
- Assist with raw material and final product inventory sample collections  
- Play a key role in the execution of project management activities and planning for projects as required. This includes managing relationships with various stakeholders and suppliers, evaluation of RFQs/RFPs, review of technical bids, and overseeing deliverables to align with project timelines and budgets 
- Support preventative and predictive maintenance programs, including maintenance planning and scheduling. 
- Contribute to project planning and execution by contractor coordination, proposal evaluation and deliverable monitoring. 
- Draft 2D and 3D models of equipment, spare parts and plot plans of facilities using the AutoCAD suite 
- Assist with raw material and final product inventory sample collections 
- Live and breathe our safety-first culture—reporting hazards, near misses, and following WHS, HAZOPs, and risk assessments. Additionally conduct investigations where directed by the line manager and implement rectifications where applicable.   
 
What You will need to Succeed:  
Bachelor’s or higher degree qualification in Chemical, Process, Electrical, Mechanical or other related Engineering field. 
A “solution mindset” and able to manage varying tasks with often changing and competing priorities.  
Familiarity with PFDs, and P&IDs, HAZOP analysis, troubleshooting procedure. 
A team player attitude who can also take initiative independently. 
Adaptable mindset, and ability to adjust on the fly. Priorities change. You roll with it. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills together with sound writing skills for reports and proposals. 
A drive to learn, innovate, improve, and be part of something meaningful. 
Strong communication skills and comfort with digital tools like MS Office  
Experience in process operations, materials handling or supply chain in the same or similar setting
 
Even Better If You Have   
Knowledge on process equipment testing and/or commissioning, as well as specifying piping and equipment layout.  
Familiarity with Mass & Energy Balance  
Knowledge of gas cylinders, chemical handling, and analytical equipment. 
Exposure to chemical plant safety frameworks like HAZOP or risk assessments. 
Knowledge of Working in Hazardous Areas Classifications  
First Aid, Fire Safety training, Working at Heights, White Card, Forklift training  
 
Why join us? 
You’ll level up.?Work alongside the brightest minds in clean tech and grow fast. 
You’ll make it real.?Help scale cutting-edge battery materials from lab to production. This is no desk gig. 
Culture with personality.?Zero egos, all drive—just good people solving hard problems together in a team that backs each other. 
We channel the cheetah-honey badger.?Fast, nimble, and absolutely fearless. Equal parts strategic and scrappy. 
Live where it’s beautiful.?Wollongong has great schools, beaches, rainforests, cycle routes, surfing, restaurants, theatres – and just a train ride away from Sydney! 
 
Who We Are 
We develop next-generation silicon-carbon (Si/C) anode materials for lithium-ion batteries—designed to significantly increase energy density and improve fast-charging performance. That’s the kind of breakthrough that gets us out of bed. Check out our website to find out more about our awesome work: https://siconabattery.com. 
We’re a team of engineers, researchers, operators, innovators, dreamers, doers and disruptors who believe climate action shouldn’t be slow—or boring. Whether it's designing new materials in the lab or scaling them in the plant, we work together to transform battery tech and accelerate the electric mobility revolution with the fast, focused, and fearless energy that defines us. 
 
This Is More Than Just a Job 
We’re not here to do things the way they’ve always been done. We’re here to?push boundaries, scale impact, and solve hard problems—together. We're fast, we're fearless, and we're doing it together – One Team, One Dream, One Sicona. 
 
If you're ready to grow, innovate, and get things done - without the fluff - apply now. 
Sicona | Be bold. Be real. Be the cheetah-honey badger.

Analytics Executive (aka: Analyst, Analytics & Insights Executive)
The Analytics Executive / Analyst is responsible for assisting the broader analytics team to drive insight backed strategic thinking. 
-	working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Marketing Platform, Data visualisation platforms like Looker, Tableau and data processing skills -SQL, Big Query . 
-	Experienced in analytics data modelling techniques and data governance process management.

-	Strong numerical and analytical skills
-	Strong experience in Excel
-	Experience across the following Office platforms: Including Word, PowerPoint
-	Experience in ETL and Visualisation solutions
-	Understanding of offline and online media will be beneficial
Salary: $85,000 - $90,000 package
Analytics Manager (aka: Analytics & Insights Manager, Data Analytics Manager) 
The role of the Analytics & Insights Manager is to be a key driver of insight and strategic thinking. Providing analytics-based strategic insights and directions to aid in the development of media & communications initiatives.
Ensuring a streamlined approach between the strategy, analytics & media teams, ensuring high quality analytical projects are effectively delivered.
•	Work with the Associate Director / Director, to design and execute analytical plans to improve the effectiveness of communications programs.

•	Work on new business projects as required.
•	Proactively seek new business opportunities.
•	Manage and mentor junior team members.
•	Efficiently collaborate with account leaders and their planning team members for planning & deployment of the optimization strategies adopted for driving paid media efficiencies on an ongoing basis. 
•	Drive platform expertise in Google GMP and Adobe Experience stack & Ad Cloud. Additional great to have hands on experience in CRM platforms such as Salesforce & Google ADH deployment. 
•	Experience managing Analytics / MarTech relationships and cross functional stakeholder management 
Salary: $85,000 - $110,000 package

The role of the Analytics & Insights Manager is to be a key driver of insight and strategic thinking. Providing analytics-based strategic insights and directions to aid in the development of media & communications initiatives.
Ensuring a streamlined approach between the strategy, analytics & media teams, ensuring high quality analytical projects are effectively delivered.

•	Work on new business projects as required.
•	Proactively seek new business opportunities.
•	Manage and mentor junior team members.
•	Efficiently collaborate with account leaders and their planning team members for planning & deployment of the optimization strategies adopted for driving paid media efficiencies on an ongoing basis. 
•	Drive platform expertise in Google GMP and Adobe Experience stack & Ad Cloud. Additional great to have hands on experience in CRM platforms such as Salesforce & Google ADH deployment. 
•	Experience managing Analytics / MarTech relationships and cross functional stakeholder management 
Analytics Director (aka: Analytics & Insights Director, Analytics & Insights Lead)
The Analytics Directors role is to understand the client’s business and chart a roadmap for the role of Data & analytics in the clients business. They will provide guidance on the key strategic use cases for Google / Adobe analytics platform, advise on data modelling methods to be used for client business intelligence needs and drive the governance on client Data management processes, platforms & methods. 
Guide the strategic insights output for clients and build the role and importance of digital analytics & Business Intelligence both in client business and to drive media & communications objectives. 
leverage analytics data for bringing efficiencies in media deliveries and highlighting opportunities for clients to leverage in their everyday business decision making. 
•	Plan and own client relationship management with mid to senior PMB account & customer stakeholders. 
•	Have in-depth understanding of digitals analytics (GMP, GA 360 platforms) (handson implementation of GA, GA360, GTM required) 
•	Plan and drive the use cases for integrating analytics with GMP to drive media & creative strategies 
•	Engage with senior account and client stakeholders and plan the analytics roadmap in the clients business and recommend best practice on data, media & technology landscape. 
•	Own and plan client absolute analytics service delivery scopes, time & effort scoping on tasks, team allocation on client tasks. 
•	Develop and maintain Advanced reporting systems working towards standardisation as a PMB output. 
•	Oversee and work alongside internal teams on new & existing client projects, campaigns and how analytics as a function can support on the same. 
•	Formally document the analytics platform tests & strategies adopted and present findings and recommendations to cross functional teams across internal and external stakeholders. 
•	Own people management & development of team members including their goal setting, ensuring their high levels of service and the day to day people management duties such as administration including timesheets and approving leave. 
•	Advanced (10+ years) & hands-on working knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Marketing Platform, Data visualisation platforms like Looker, Tableau and data processing skills -SQL, Big Query . 
•	Advanced experience of GMP product suite, Adobe (good to have), leveraged research platforms/ tools in business and audience insights generation and planning.
•	Experienced in analytics data modelling techniques and data governance process management. 
•	An influential leader who can translate their skills and guide their team to deliver enhanced data and actionable insights. 
•	Experience in drafting and planning analytics scope and role in support of media and creative client projects and should’ve driven successful implementation of the same. – Good story telling/ presentation skills to convert data into client resonating presentations
Salary $120,000k Package + 
•	All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification with 2 or more years’ experience in a similar role OR a minimum of 5 years relevant work experience in lieu of qualification.
•	Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Sponsorship Available
MYAC Resources is currently recruiting experienced Mechanical Fitters for multiple 
permanent, full-time opportunities across Perth, Western Australia and Townsville, 
Queensland.
We partner with leading Australian employers across manufacturing, heavy industry, 
mining, engineering and industrial sectors, offering long-term career opportunities 
with reputable businesses.
Whether you are already in Australia or looking to relocate from overseas, we 
encourage suitably qualified Mechanical Fitters to apply. Employer sponsorship is 
available for eligible candidates, subject to employer requirements and Australian 
migration regulations.
About the Role
As a Mechanical Fitter, you will be responsible for the installation, maintenance, 
repair and servicing of industrial machinery and mechanical equipment to ensure 
safe and efficient operations.
Depending on the employer and project, your responsibilities may include:
• Mechanical maintenance, servicing and fault finding on industrial plant and 
equipment 
• Preventative maintenance and scheduled servicing 
• Breakdown repairs to minimise downtime 
• Installation, alignment and commissioning of mechanical equipment 
• Repair and replacement of bearings, motors, pumps, gearboxes, conveyors 
and other mechanical components 
• Hydraulic and pneumatic maintenance 
• Reading and interpreting engineering drawings and technical documentation 
• Performing equipment inspections and reporting maintenance requirements 
• Completing maintenance records and documentation 
• Working safely in accordance with company procedures and WHS 
requirements 
Collaborating with maintenance and production teams to maximise equipment 
reliability 
About You
To be successful, you will ideally have:
• Certificate III in Engineering – Mechanical Trade (Mechanical Fitter) or 
equivalent recognised trade qualification 
• Previous experience in manufacturing, heavy industry, mining, industrial 
maintenance or engineering environments 
• Strong mechanical fault-finding and diagnostic skills 
• Experience maintaining rotating equipment and industrial machinery 
• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals 
• Strong problem-solving ability 
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
• Commitment to workplace health and safety 
Highly Regarded
The following experience and licences are advantageous:
• Experience within mining, manufacturing or steel processing 
• Hydraulic and pneumatic systems experience 
• Conveyor and materials handling equipment experience 
• Welding and fabrication experience 
• Forklift Licence 
• Overhead Crane Licence 
• Elevated Work Platform (EWP) 
• Confined Space and Working at Heights tickets 
• Experience using maintenance management systems (CMMS)
Employer Sponsorship Available
MYAC Resources has extensive experience assisting Australian businesses to 
recruit skilled tradespeople from both within Australia and overseas.
For suitably qualified candidates, employer sponsorship may be available, subject to 
employer approval and Australian migration requirements.
If you are seeking to build a long-term career in Australia, we would love to hear from 
you.
What's on Offer
• Permanent full-time opportunities 
• Positions available in Perth, WA and Townsville, QLD
• Competitive salary packages with overtime opportunities 
• Long-term career progression 
• Work with established Australian employers 
• Ongoing training and professional development 
• Safe, supportive and well-managed workplaces 
• Employer sponsorship available for eligible candidates 
Why MYAC Resources?
MYAC Resources specialises in recruiting skilled professionals across Australia's 
manufacturing, engineering, mining, construction and industrial sectors.
We focus on building long-term careers by connecting talented tradespeople with 
quality employers throughout Australia. Our experienced recruitment team provides 
support throughout every stage of the recruitment process, from application through 
to placement and, where applicable, employer sponsorship.

Apply today with your current resume and one of our recruitment specialists will be in 
touch

Designing, coding, testing and installing applications programs up to 75% of the time, either in one major program or a range of programs across multiple platforms.
Preparing and maintaining systems and program documentation.
Assisting in the analysis and design of applications programs and databases.
Modifying and troubleshooting applications programs.
Liaising with users.

Core responsibilities:
Development:
· Work with Business Analysts to analyse business processes, procedures and user requirements in order to establish system requirements.
· Participate in system design including production of system and program documentation as well as ongoing maintenance
· Develop solutions and specifications so that agreed requirements can be converted into functional systems
· Develop, program and code technology applications software solutions to meet agreed specifications. Improve, enhance and correct systems as necessary

· Ensure all work is carried out in accordance with required standards, methods and procedures

· Develop comprehensive test scripts and scenarios based on testing plan in accordance with standard procedures and templates

· Appropriately use progress/tracking tools and complete administration activities
· Test, launch and help train users in new systems
· Work with business users (in conjunction with Business Analysts) to clarify requirements, resolve issues
· Document systems and produce desk procedures for ongoing user use. End user support/ 2nd level Help Desk
· Contribute to maintaining operating environments to enable testing which reflects user environments
· May undertake evaluation and quality reviews of system development processes and practices and thereby contribute to the overall effectiveness of the function/ team.

Salary $80K - $95K

result.description: Savic Motorcycles Limited   About the Role   We are seeking a Mechanical Engineer to design, develop, validate and improve the mechanical systems, components and manufacturing processes of the Savic C-Series electric motorcycle platform. This is an engineering role covering the full product lifecycle, from concept design through to production readiness, with genuine ownership of components and systems on a market-leading Australian-designed electric motorcycle.   Key Responsibilities    Design, develop and optimise mechanical components, assemblies and vehicle systems for the Savic C-Series platform and upcoming models, including chassis, suspension, bodywork, mounting systems and structural components.  Translate performance, durability, safety and manufacturing requirements into engineering specifications, drawings, tolerances and technical documentation.  Develop manufacturing-ready designs using Design for Manufacture and Assembly principles, GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and material selection.  Perform and support engineering analysis including finite element analysis, fatigue analysis and topology optimisation, and develop and execute mechanical test plans and validation procedures.  Support the transition of designs from prototype to repeatable, production-ready manufacture, including release of manufacturing drawings, work instructions and inspection requirements.  Design or support the development of jigs, fixtures, gauges and other production aids to improve quality, safety and repeatability.  Maintain Engineering Change Management records, Bills of Materials, drawing releases and New Product Introduction documentation, including DFMEA, PFMEA and PPAP activities.  Lead FRACAS Meetings focusing on analysis, quality assurance and continuous improvement functions of mechanical components, in alignment with the software, systems and electrical engineering teams.    Support structured root-cause analysis and corrective action processes and maintain fault and corrective action records in Notion or other nominated engineering systems.  Identify opportunities to improve cost, manufacturability, weight and performance of components and assemblies, and evaluate alternative materials and manufacturing methods.  Work closely with Electrical, Software, Systems, Manufacturing, Quality and Aftersales teams to ensure mechanical systems integrate effectively with the wider vehicle platform.    What We're Looking For    Bachelor degree or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline.  Demonstrated experience designing, developing and validating mechanical components, assemblies or systems in an automotive, motorcycle, EV, manufacturing, aerospace, robotics or related product-development environment.  Strong capability in mechanical design for manufacture, including GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis, materials selection, manufacturing drawings and production documentation.  Experience with engineering analysis and validation methods, including FEA, fatigue assessment, physical testing, data acquisition or structured test planning.  Experience applying engineering quality and risk-management methods such as DFMEA, PFMEA, 8D, 5D, DMAIC, DFSS, PPAP or equivalent.  Experience supporting engineering change management, BOM control, drawing release and New Product Introduction processes.  Strong practical understanding of manufacturing processes, tooling, jigs, fixtures, machining, casting, fabrication or assembly methods.  Proficient with CAD, PLM/PDM, project management, engineering documentation and issue-tracking systems; experience with Notion, Jira, Odoo or equivalent systems is highly regarded.    Our Brand   In this role, you will act in accordance with our brand values and help us deliver our brand vision: to make EV riding enjoyable to every rider in the world.   We put people first — our customers are at the heart of what we do.  We design in Australia — being an Aussie brand is in our DNA.  We make informed decisions — using data, insights and experience.  We actually care — each person is personally passionate about what we're doing.      About Company      Savic Motorcycles is redefining the electric motorcycle industry with premium, high-performance machines that blend cutting-edge technology, sleek design and an exclusive brand experience. Our Engineering team is responsible for ensuring Savic motorcycles are safe, reliable, manufacturable, commercially viable, and continuously improving as the business scales. ## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Your new company     An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Infrastructure Engineer to join a well-established technology services organisation with a growing presence in Tasmania.  Based in Hobart, this permanent role will see you supporting and improving enterprise Linux and cloud environments that underpin critical services across the state. Working closely with both local and national engineering teams, you'll play a key role in maintaining platform stability, security and operational excellence in mission-critical environments where availability and reliability are paramount.    Your new role     As an Infrastructure Engineer, you will be responsible for administering and supporting Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) environments, ensuring systems remain secure, available and performing at their best. You will manage patching and upgrades, monitor infrastructure health, respond to incidents, and contribute to ongoing platform improvement initiatives.  Working across Azure and AWS environments, you'll help strengthen infrastructure resilience, support security and compliance requirements, and participate in a 24/7 on-call roster. You'll take ownership of critical incidents from identification through to resolution, applying strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills while working within established change management and governance frameworks. You'll also be responsible for conducting root cause analysis and maintaining operational documentation and standards.    What you'll need to succeed   
 
 Mandatory RHCE (Red Hat Certified Engineer) certification 
 Strong experience administering enterprise Linux/RHEL environments 
 Infrastructure engineering experience within enterprise or managed services environments 
 Experience supporting Azure and/or AWS platforms 
 Strong troubleshooting, incident management and problem-solving skills 
 Experience with patching, upgrades, system hardening and vulnerability remediation 
 Strong communication skills and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively 
 The ability to pass a mandatory police check 
 
 Highly regarded: 
 
 Experience within utilities, critical infrastructure, OT environments or managed services 
 
  What you'll get in return     You'll join a growing Hobart engineering team backed by experienced national engineering resources across Australia. In return, you'll gain exposure to enterprise scale Linux and cloud environments, enjoy flexible hybrid working arrangements, receive an on-call allowance, and have the opportunity to further develop your career within a collaborative and technically focused organisation that values accountability, continuous improvement and technical excellence. Phillip Riley has an opportunity for a Software Engineer.

The successful candidate will also be responsible for the leading and/or assisting with planning and execution of migration activities for both physical and virtual environments.

The Specified Personnel will report to the Senior Data Centre Manager of the Data Centre Infrastructure Support team who is responsible for managing and maintaining the Department’s Data Centres.

The services will include and not be limited to:

Developing solution designs and following up with direct involvement in the solutions implementation.
Implementing solutions in line with industry, vendor and Department best practice.
Providing specialist advice for projects and teams to ensure “best practice” implementations; Working with Project Managers to define and schedule deliverables.
Liaising regularly with project stakeholders and ICT stakeholders as necessary.
The right person will have:

Minimum of 1 year of experience in a similar role 
Demonstrated experience in data centre design and migration.
Strong solution design and hands-on deployment within the data centre environment.
Demonstrated ability to apply high quality detailed technical knowledge to ensure solutions are implemented effectively with a strong emphasis on high quality;
Possess good written and verbal communication skills, particularly relevant in translating technical information to non-technical peers and stakeholders.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

$87,500 - $107,500 + Super

Job Type: Full-time
